title: Protocolometry G15 Independent Methodological Review Rubric

review_domains.name: Construct validity and scope
questions: Do D1-D4 and I01-I20 measure the stated institutional constructs rather than prestige, scale or publicity?
Are material construct gaps or overlaps identified?

review_domains.name: Scoring anchors and reproducibility
questions: Are 0-5/NE anchors sufficiently distinct and operational?
Do the rules support independent reproducible scoring without mechanical averaging of disagreement?

review_domains.name: Evidence model and provenance
questions: Are source tiers and score/evidence requirements proportionate and auditable?
Are Tier D, URL-presence and provenance boundaries clear?

review_domains.name: Missingness and coverage
questions: Do 80% overall / 60% per-dimension thresholds avoid converting missing evidence into a hidden penalty?
Are NE, verified zero and withholding rules distinguishable?

review_domains.name: Weights and redundancy
questions: Are candidate weights defensible relative to the constructs?
Are weight-sensitivity and redundancy controls adequate?

review_domains.name: Peer-type, language and regional fairness
questions: Could any peer type be structurally advantaged by indicators unrelated to intended quality?
Could English-language abundance, web visibility, geography or institutional scale act as hidden quality proxies?

review_domains.name: Anti-gaming and manipulation resistance
questions: Are known gaming routes blocked without over-penalising legitimate institutions?
Can duplicated evidence, marketing-only claims or strategic NE use distort scores?

review_domains.name: Correction, appeals and COI governance
questions: Are correction provenance, version history, reviewer COI and recusal operationally clear?
Can payment, sponsorship or institutional relationships affect outcomes?

review_domains.name: Shadow Index and release boundaries
questions: Are Shadow Index, v1.0 freeze and publication decisions sufficiently separated?
Can any software path activate public ranking automatically?

review_domains.name: Freeze integrity and change control
questions: Does the freeze-candidate package identify all normative assets and preserve change history?
Are final checksums generated only after accepted review changes?

review_domains.name: Public claims and limitations
questions: Are measurement/accreditation/recognition boundaries accurate?
Are limitations, uncertainty and unresolved issues visible enough for consequential use?

finding_severities.OBSERVATION: No change required; useful contextual note.
finding_severities.MINOR: Clarification or low-risk correction advisable before final freeze.
finding_severities.MAJOR: Material methodological or governance change required before final freeze.
finding_severities.CRITICAL: Final freeze must not proceed until resolved or explicitly withdrawn from the candidate.

rules: Every material finding must cite the reviewed asset/version and explain the methodological concern.
Reviewer conclusions are recommendations, not an automatic G14 or G16 decision.
WPA must record ACCEPT / PARTIAL_ACCEPT / DECLINE / DEFER for every MINOR, MAJOR or CRITICAL finding.
A declined material finding requires written reasoning.
Any follow-up review requested by the reviewer remains open until explicitly closed.
Review is not described as peer review, accreditation, recognition or endorsement.
